sections.brief: Hook. The CPU chip pops in. At cue:slow the big RAM bar rises in with its 100 ns tag, and a huge 100x stat lands at right with a one-word 'slower' caption, then both clear. At cue:closer the blue Cache bar pops in between chip and RAM with its 1 ns tag, and a brief caption 'keeps your frequently-used data close' appears and clears. End on key s1: chip, Cache and RAM all visible.

The lookup. At cue:asks an amber byte leaves the CPU and flies down into the cache, with a dashed fetch arrow drawn ahead of it; a caption 'checks the cache first' appears and clears. At cue:hit the byte pulses, flashes green, and a green HIT badge pops above it, then pops out. End on key s2: the byte sitting in the cache.

Miss and eviction. At cue:miss the cache flashes red and a second amber byte appears at the CPU, hops to the cache, bounces on to RAM (which pulses) with a red dashed miss arrow, and a red MISS badge pops, then everything for this beat clears. At cue:out an 'LRU' tag appears on the byte still in the cache, the byte turns gray, is thrown out of the cache to the right and fades. A closing caption 'throw out the least-recently-used' fades in and holds. Last section: nothing needs to clear.
